rationale: Disjoint 3-way partition: dev (20 v1 cases, including motivating unsupported/causal cluster uns-001..003 and multi-005), regression (17 previously exercised v1 cases preserved as a regression suite), and holdout (10 fresh unseen cases in datasets/holdout/v1/cases.jsonl with independent DuckDB SQL reference facts and zero overlap with dev, regression, or prompt bundles). Every split covers all 5 categories and keeps multi-turn scenarios whole.
